newsitem.title: USA: Quality Food Centers to list on NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Quality Food Centers to list on NYSE.

text.p: Quality Food Centers Inc said Wednesday it has filed an application to list its common stock on the New York Stock Exchange.
The company said its shares will continue trading on the Nasdaq until the NYSE listing is effective, expected to be on or about Feb. 20.

"We've been pleased with our relationship with the NASD but at this time we believe listing on the New York Stock Exchange has many advantages for our individual and institutional investors, the most important of which are enhanced visibility, improved liquidity and an exceptionally efficient market for the company's stock," QFC president and chief executive officer Chris Sinclair said in a statement.

QFC has 64 grocery stores, mostly in the Seattle area, and recently announced plans to acquire the Hughes Family Markets chain in Southern California and the Keith Uddenberg Inc chain in the Puget Sound region as part of its long-term strategy to become a "premier multi-regional operator."
